description: Defines a 'Size' struct representing a 2D size with methods for manipulation, validation, rotation, and clamping, within the android::ui namespace.

classes.name: Size
classes.description: A simple value type representing a two-dimensional size with utility methods.

methods.name: Size(T w, T h)
methods.description: Template constructor initializing size with width and height, with clamping.

methods.name: isValid()
methods.description: Checks if size has non-negative width and height.

methods.name: isEmpty()
methods.description: Checks if size is empty (zero width and height).

methods.name: rotate(Rotation rotation)
methods.description: Applies rotation; transposes size if rotation is 90 or 270 degrees.

methods.name: clamp<ToType, FromType>(v)
methods.description: Clamps a value to the range of ToType based on FromType, with type conversion.
